digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, and skill discipline
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation and trend-queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must prevent: raw git writes bypassing the store, unread config schema fields, unchecked AC checkboxes at close, wall-clock asserts in tests, and oversized bug fixes without plan review.
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python following the strangler-fig policy.
Canary and automation bug filing must follow a hardened deduplication pattern with a documented bug-creation contract.
Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression prevention.
Skill discipline upgrades (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, test-design) must encode two-axis invariant sweeps, surface census, config-effect contrast, and gate-finding oracle improvements.
